profile_text.body:
Weaviate is an Amsterdam-based company that develops an open-source vector database aimed at developers building AI-native applications. The company describes its product as reducing hallucination, data leakage, and vendor lock-in, and it offers the database alongside a managed cloud service called Weaviate Cloud. The platform supports a GraphQL interface, hybrid search, and EU-hosted deployment with GDPR compliance.

The company's documentation and learning resources reference additional components including a Query Agent and guides oriented toward LLM and agent-based workflows. Weaviate maintains a community presence through a forum, academy, and developer program called the Weaviate Hero Program. No litigation, SEC filings, MCP server registrations, or patent records are held for the company at this time.
